rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone firmly resolved to do something.

example.english: I am determined not to bow to difficulties.
example.traditional: 我堅決唔會向困難低頭。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 kyut3 m4 wui5 hoeng3 kwan3 naan4 dai1 tau4

rows.note: Use this for steadfast resolve or an unwavering attitude, rather than a single firm decision.

example.english: I remain determined in my beliefs.
example.traditional: 我對自己嘅信念一直都好堅定。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 seon3 nim6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gin1 ding6

rows.note: Use this when highlighting dogged perseverance or a resolute personal character.

example.english: They showed a determined character and finally got through the crisis.
example.traditional: 佢表現出堅毅嘅性格，終於捱過難關。
example.jyutping: keoi5 biu2 jin6 ceot1 gin1 ngai6 ge3 sing3 gaak3 zung1 jyu1 ngaai4 gwo3 naan4 gwaan1
